chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, he said: Ali, peace be upon him, said:
"Every place that is entered without permission, and a thief steals from it, then there is no cutting off upon him."

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakuni, the narrator through whom this report is transmitted
key_terms.قَطْعَ: the legal cutting of the hand as punishment
key_terms.مَدْخَلٍ: a place of entry or an accessible location

ai.seo_question: When is the hadd punishment for theft not applied in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning theft and the application of the hadd punishment. It indicates that when property is taken from a place that is not secured from entry and can be entered without permission, the punishment of hand-cutting does not apply.
